title: A separated etale morphism is finite etale on a constructible stratification
statement: Let $Y$ be a quasi-compact and quasi-separated scheme [def-weil-pbc-scheme-conventions], and let $f:V\to Y$ be a separated etale morphism [def-weil-etale-morphism]. Then there exists a finite partition $Y=\coprod_rY_r$ by constructible locally closed subschemes [def-weil-constructible-subset] such that each base change $V\times_Y Y_r\to Y_r$ is finite etale [def-weil-pbc-finite-etale-category].

source.place: More on Morphisms, Lemma Tag 07RZ (more-morphisms-lemma-stratify-flat-fp-qf), together with Etale Morphisms: etale implies flat, locally of finite presentation and quasi-finite; the finite locally free strata are finite etale after base change
